key_insight: BASOC reduces nonlinear optimal-control problems by balancing state variation along locally optimal trajectories with directions of high value-function sensitivity.
engineering_relevance: The framework could support real-time feedback control of high-dimensional nonlinear systems by enabling reduced-order models and surrogate control laws.
method: Use trajectory optimization and Pontryagin’s minimum principle to collect state and co-state data.
Construct and balance state and value-gradient covariance matrices.
Use the resulting oblique projection to approximate the value function in reduced coordinates.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports demonstrations on a nonlinear three-dimensional system and the nonlinear complex Ginzburg–Landau equation, plus equivalence to closed-loop initial-condition balancing in the linear-quadratic case.
watch_item: Reliance on locally optimal trajectory data may limit accuracy outside the sampled state regions.
paper_title: Balanced Active Subspaces for Optimal Control via Trajectory Optimization
